name: List All Community Association Homeowner Ledgers
description: Returns all Community Association ledgers that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[AssociationId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the Community Association. All GET requests must include filters for [AssociationId], [DateFrom], and [DateTo].

queryFilters.name: filters[DateFrom]
queryFilters.description: The start date for filtering homeowner ledger records. All GET requests must include filters for [AssociationId], [DateFrom], and [DateTo].

queryFilters.name: filters[DateTo]
queryFilters.description: The end date for filtering homeowner ledger records. All GET requests must include filters for [AssociationId], [DateFrom], and [DateTo].

responseFields.name: data[].OccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the occupancy associated with the ledger

responseFields.name: data[].Ledger
responseFields.description: This contains the charges, payments, and credits for the occupancy specified by the OccupancyId

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
